title: The Verdier Manor Affair
situation: On March 14 at 11:10 PM, you were found in the living room of Verdier Manor, kneeling beside the body of Henri Verdier, your hands covered in blood.

evidence.name: Blood on your hands
evidence.description: The blood on your hands belongs to the victim.

evidence.name: Phone call
evidence.description: The victim called you at 10:45 PM. The call lasted 2 minutes.

evidence.name: Witness
evidence.description: The neighbor saw a silhouette leave the manor through the garden around 10:50 PM.

evidence.name: Knife
evidence.description: The weapon was found in the kitchen, with no fingerprints.

evidence.name: Footprints
evidence.description: Muddy size 44 (US 10.5) footprints in the hallway. You wear a size 42 (US 9).

evidence.name: Window
evidence.description: The study window was broken from the inside.

prosecutorQuestions: Why were you at the manor that night?
What did the victim tell you on the phone?
How do you explain the blood on your hands?
Did you go into the kitchen?
Did you see anyone else in the house?
